scope: Six sampled frames of each completed original/swapped/zero video; not continuous listening, quantitative beat adherence or user ratings
single_parameter_ablation: length_weight0.01 versus B length_weight1; same full-backbone/adapter initialization, data, order, budget and student condition

assessment.staircase: Original and swapped retain arm gestures and rear leg curl; zero also follows the same general motif. White/blue sportswear and a bag replace the reference light-yellow top and grey trousers.
assessment.red_outfit: Original/swapped largely retain face/mouth gesture, head turn and one-arm lift; zero changes the later arm extension and opens both arms at the final sampled frame, but does not establish song-conditioned choreography.
assessment.shop: Original/swapped/zero retain mostly stationary single-arm gestures with small shifts, rather than a clearly distinct dance sequence.

limitations: Predicted effective H lengths and packed layouts change across original/swapped/zero inputs.
Pixel MAE and local pose changes are not proof of matching the song or paired caption.
These observations concern the 100-update model; the 300-update models must be assessed separately.
Four-sample gradient magnitudes do not prove that length loss is the sole cause of weak control.
